Currently there are fifteen federal National Incident Support Caches that are strategically located across the nation. All supplies in the cache system are managed within the National Fire Equipment System. During a wildfire that goes beyond one shift, firefighting supplies are delivered from the nearest cache to the incident to support fire suppression efforts.
